remarks: Charming on the outside & exceptional on the inside, this completely renovated Cape Cod is set on a spacious, level, and lush property in Norwalk's highly sought-after William Street neighborhood. This 3 bedroom 2 full bath gem seamlessly blends timeless character with modern luxury!  The renovation-begun in 2022 & is recently completed-features a brand-new HVAC system with gas heat & central air, upgraded electrical panel, 50-gallon hot water heater, whole-house humidifier, & dual-zone smart thermostats.  The stunning 2023 custom kitchen boasts quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, stainless steel KitchenAid appliances, a propane gas range, large Silgranit sink, and new Andersen windows and sliding doors with UV protection.  Both bathrooms (2025) showcase Moen and Kohler fixtures, including a walk-in shower and deep soaking tub. A custom acoustical soundproofing wall between the first-floor bedroom and living area enhances comfort and privacy.  Outdoor living shines with a Trex deck overlooking a large backyard-ideal for entertaining. Additional highlights include a deep one-car garage with custom built-ins & a well-equipped basement with laundry, stainless steel sink, & sump pump.  Ideally located just off I-95 Exit 16 and minutes from Calf Pasture Beach, Westport boutiques & dining, SoNo Collection Mall, and East Norwalk Railroad with easy NYC access. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle-this is the rental you've been waiting for!
